newsitem.title: USA: Arthur J. Gallagher may take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Arthur J. Gallagher may take Q4 charge.

text.p: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co, noting a market trend of about five to 10 percent less in renewal business across most lines, said it was reviewing costs and related expenses and would not rule out a substantial one-time restructuring charge.
Preident J. Patrick Gallagher Jr in a statement also said the company does not expect fourth quarter results to reach levels attained during the year-ago period.
A reduction in the company's incentive compensation plans due to the commission shortfall also played a large part in contributing to the net earnings growth of the third quarter.
Despite these results, the company said it does not anticipate any change in the short-term insurance markets.
In the year-ago fourth quarter, Arthur J. Gallagher reported earnings of $0.83 per share.
